title: Virtual Shadow Maps & Shadow Depths Overhead
fix_rationale: Virtual Shadow Maps (VSM) and shadow depth rendering are consuming a significant portion of GPU frame time. High-frequency mesh invalidations, high physical page counts, or unoptimized light counts force heavy shadow projection passes.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) rendering shadow depth maps.

fixes.text: Adjust Virtual Shadow Map resolution LOD bias (r.Shadow.Virtual.ResolutionLodBias -1.0 to 1.0).
Limit maximum physical shadow pages pool size (r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages 2048).
Disable dynamic shadow casting on small foliage, prop meshes, or non-critical local lights.
Enable r.Shadow.Virtual.Cache to preserve static page caching across frames.

verify: Adjust r.Shadow.Virtual.ResolutionLodBias and verify that ShadowDepths / VirtualShadowMap pass durations drop.
